catalogSource: scripts/audit-ability-catalog.js (local catalog file or committed HEAD snapshot)

verification.note: Aggregate parsing or a passing pattern test does not make a whole card fully verified. Only explicit manifest records count as regression evidence; zero fully verified cards is reported when no complete card-level evidence exists.

workflow.parseCacheExperiment: Rejected JSON-clone-per-call caching after three full catalog parse passes measured about 9.5 seconds uncached versus 12.1 seconds with cloning. Adopted immutable per-card snapshots with definition-revision invalidation: the same three passes measured about 9.5 seconds uncached versus 3.82 seconds cached; cache-hit passes were about 2.5 milliseconds each.

measuredBottlenecks.area: Repeated catalog parsing in regression tests
measuredBottlenecks.evidence: 84 parseCardAbilities references in the 95-test catalog suite; a full catalog parse is about 3.4-3.8 seconds.
measuredBottlenecks.optimization: Immutable per-card parse snapshots, shared by audit and catalog regressions.
measuredBottlenecks.result: Catalog test file 16.61 seconds on its first cached run and 13.04 seconds after audit/cache integration; the 494-test optimization milestone took 37.96 seconds versus 245.62 seconds before the cache.

measuredBottlenecks.evidence: Full Node suite measured 245.62 seconds before the cache and 37.96 seconds after it.
measuredBottlenecks.optimization: Run focused rule/worker checks per ability batch and reserve the full suite for milestones.
measuredBottlenecks.result: Latest full suite: 1409/1409 passed in 230.83 seconds.

measuredBottlenecks.area: Manual card semantics and validation backlog
measuredBottlenecks.evidence: 13013 ability blocks remain unsupported or unreviewed; 9949 cards contain at least one such block. Repository history has no per-stage time logs to substantiate the reported 22 hours.
measuredBottlenecks.optimization: Process exact recurring templates in reusable batches; preserve per-card evidence and leave ambiguous text unreviewed.
measuredBottlenecks.result: Reusable Soul-count power and critical patterns plus signed continuous power adjustments cover the current verified examples; per-card evidence stays partial until the other printed abilities are implemented.
